name: seed
description: Hand-written evaluation pairs carried over from the raw-Python build. Two tiers: lexical regression guards, and natural-language questions. Expected answers are substrings so the set survives re-chunking.

conventions.company: lowercase ticker — must match filing metadata exactly
conventions.expected_substring: distinctive but forgiving; sourced from CLEANED filing text, never from a browser view
conventions.tier_1: near-tautological — a failure here means the harness or index is broken, not that retrieval is weak
conventions.tier_2: realistic phrasing — this is the number that should actually move

known_issues: 'net sales' is loose enough to match many chunks and can produce a false positive — tighten when the set grows
'Powerwall' appears in exactly one TSLA chunk, so that item is unusually easy
8 items is thin; target is 25+ before any retrieval claim carries weight

items.query: what was Apple's total revenue this year?
What are Microsoft's main business segments?
What products make up Tesla's energy business?
